_meta.label: Phoenix Directive
_meta.summary: Community-led Terra stewardship initiative (BORG structure) funded by an Alliance-staked virtual token; steward of chain core, the Alliance module, and the largest single briber in TLA vote markets. Founding doc, publication set, GitHub org, treasury contract and deployed address all sourced.

facts.claim: Phoenix Directive regularly adds bribes (vote incentives) to TLA pools, making it a notable participant in TLA's vote market. Bribes attract votes toward specific pools each epoch.
facts.notes: Role stated in our curated protocols.json. A primary-source writeup (who runs it, how formed) is still needed — placeholder until sourced.

facts.claim: Phoenix Foundation / Phoenix Directive is associated with Terra phoenix-1 chain stewardship following the Terraform Labs collapse, including Protocol-Owned Liquidity management.

PD is a BORG-structured network: Terra Governance (ultimate veto) > Think Tank (ideas; veto on >$50k spends, 3-day lockup) > Task Forces (execution) > Stewardship Team (0xPhilipp, MBaejir, Evan_Phoen1x; the Phoenix Foundation BORG) > Phoenix Treasury. Spends >$150k have a 10-day lockup vetoable by Terra Governance.

The Phoenix Treasury is funded by a smart contract that mints a virtual token staked via the Alliance module; staking rewards are periodically claimed into the treasury. Governance can stop funding at any time by delisting the virtual asset.

PD's founding document self-caps its Alliance Liquidity Wars participation at 'max 20% of total voting power' (verbatim). The cap as written addresses voting-power participation; bribe-steered VP is a distinct channel and must be reported separately.

The Phoenix Treasury contract ('phoenix-treasury') was built by Eris Protocol in github.com/erisprotocol/contracts-ve3 and audited by SCV at commits 911ec9f22a793c5cee653f2011cf8eadee1c3f40 and 2c397031fde53f29e3abbcec250c731311c6e6a1. Audit scope: virtual-token Alliance staking, DCA+OTC, milestone/vesting payments, veto and spending-limit enforcement, on-chain oracles.

PD treasury deployed contract: terra16st8yfprkdl06kccktshd3p2vccq93xcn9mkhjl8s4jumyjtd4kqye0me5 (virtual token factory/<addr>/vt), listed by gov prop #4822 'Launching the Phoenix Directive Treasury' (passed 2024-10-07) with reward_weight 0.14 FIXED (min=max) and module take_rate 0.
facts.notes: Founding doc said 'initially 10%'; chain says 14% — chain wins; divergence recorded.

facts.claim: PD's stated allocation philosophy (closest published criteria): TLA redirects staking emissions into targeted incentives so 'liquidity is continuously positioned where it is most effective'; flow: staking emissions > incentives > liquidity > market activity. Granular volume/liquidity formula unpublished as of 2026-08-21.

PD claims 'The Take Rate ensures that permanent chain owned liquidity grows each day.' Distinguish layers: x/alliance module take_rate on TLA and PD virtual tokens was 0 at creation (props #4817/#4822); the TLA-context take rate is the Eris hub-level ampLP yearly_take_rate. Two MsgUpdateAlliance props in the seed remain unchecked before asserting 'still zero'.

PD's GitHub org (github.com/phoenix-directive, 'Phoenix Foundation') holds 11 public repos incl. Terra core (active Jun 2026), the x/alliance module, alliance-nft-collection (the aDAO NFT collection source), enterprise-contracts, and a DAODAO secondary GUI — the stewardship mandate visible in code.

PoL program (gov prop #4844, forum-executed): 30M LUNA community-pool spend to 3-of-5 multisig terra1kzkrm2a8qquer9dgztg4a3fvhh8d7fudsd7ualae843wsv9plhksv8ea3g; deployed into USDC-ampLUNA PCL (multisig owns 100.000% of LP) and LUNA-ampLUNA PCL (80.819%); fee rule: reinvest if LUNA>$1, burn if <=$1; first burn calc 2026-02-25 ~58,499 LUNA-equivalent; 24-month sunset. Signers self-disclosed: Philipp terra1vm5azhvaxeanc7auxh02y8jmxrk8tj93f6aywp, MB terra1qu0ych3xv4455m8p3h8877yeehn2s70newxd7p, Andre terra1np5em0379k8hc90chdzfsfgjgtm7xk8d0td77t, David terra1j00tmfa8el568llp3y96dquc9j2fcczmccnsn0, Vini terra18ruqkccl5tp493uhvra0u6jylrzq8t8dv5qs4c.
facts.notes: POL sits inside TLA-tracked pools: label as community POL in dashboards, not member/mercenary liquidity.

facts.claim: Under the PoL proposal, the Astroport TEAM committed 50% of its Terra-pool revenue share as Astro Wars bribes, proportional to each pool's trading fees (example: $100 fees -> ~$8 bribes). This is a program commitment, NOT core Astroport mechanics (core: maker fee buys ASTRO for xASTRO stakers).
